title: Knowledge Economy, Startups and Micro-Enterprises — measured pilot

ownership.note: Institutional page identity alone is not independent domain verification.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 2 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 12 timing attempts recorded of 12 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
2 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
homepage: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
language: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.

Only two distinct holding pages were declared because the observed primary site directs visitors to development notices. This narrower sample cannot be compared as equivalent to a complete three-page institutional/service sample.
The December 2026 conference dates describe an event; they are not treated as evidence of an editorial publication/update history.
External agency/fund/startup links were not visited, used or scored. The contact form was not submitted and independent domain confirmation remains pending.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 1 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 1 assessed budget points. 0/2 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 37 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 1 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Mobile homepage loading
findings.detail: Median lab LCP 19.86 seconds, range 19.24–20.25 seconds across three successful simulated runs. This operator-network result is not a field percentile or every visitor's experience.

findings.title: Replace the privacy-policy placeholder

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Normal hostname/chain/date-verified HTTPS succeeded on every declared core page. This does not enumerate supported protocols or ciphers.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: Every core response sets enforced CSP. Weaker header policies without a complete meta-policy inventory remain unmeasured because combined enforcement is unresolved. Full requires no flagged static policy weakness; half requires restrictive script and object sources despite other gaps. A header without meaningful script/object restrictions earns zero. Multiple-policy interactions remain unmeasured pending manual analysis. No exploit resistance is certified.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Headers and passive public metadata. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

Credit applies to consistency of the two captured placeholder pages only. Fresh robots denial is disclosed and does not establish current service availability.

rows.reason: Both language samples state the ministry mission and name supervised entities, but a complete organization structure or substantive department responsibilities are not supplied. Partial mission/organization availability only.

rows.label: Public services clearly listed
rows.reason: Both declared primary pages explicitly state that the website is under development and contain holding/contact information and related-entity links, without a ministry service catalogue. This is a confirmed absence in the narrow holding-page sample, not a conclusion that linked external agencies have no services.

rows.reason: The English and Arabic holding samples do not provide application steps or eligibility instructions for ministry services. The development notice explains the limited content; external service procedures were not inspected.

rows.label: No significant broken internal links
